name: Niklas von Reylander
source:
Job: Gentleman
Skill: Siren’s Call
Hobby: Cooking, dancing, drinking, arcane studies
Loves: Good food, good clothes, and good company
Pet Peeve: Prudish people, stupid rules

“I’m afraid I was doomed to love you since the moment I saw you.”
 
Niklas has it all: money, looks, name and power. Passionate, confident and seductive, he’s a good lover and the most talented practitioner of Dark Magic his family has ever seen.

[From the game's [url=http://kissesandcurses.voltage-ent.com/index.php/characters/]website[/url]]
